rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person or task that demands high standards or precision.

example.english: This client is demanding when it comes to data accuracy.
example.traditional: 個客對數據準確度要求高。
example.jyutping: go3 haak3 deoi3 sou3 geoi3 zeon2 kok3 dou6 jiu1 kau4 gou1

rows.note: Use this especially for a person or situation that is difficult to deal with or satisfy, rather than simply one with high standards.

example.english: That client is really demanding; they want changes again after we make them.
example.traditional: 嗰位客人真係難搞，改完又要改。
example.jyutping: go2 wai2 haak3 jan4 zan1 hai6 naan4 gaau2 goi2 jyun4 jau6 jiu3 goi2

rows.note: Use this for work, journeys, terrain, or activities that require considerable physical effort or endurance.

example.english: Walking this stretch of mountain road is demanding.
example.jyutping: haang4 ni1 dyun6 saan1 lou6 zan1 hai6 san1 fu2
